differences.native: MySQL subtracts each partitioned ROW_NUMBER from login_date with DATE_SUB and INTERVAL DAY.
differences.app: SQLite subtracts the same ROW_NUMBER from julianday(login_date).
differences.rationale: SQLite cannot parse MySQL's DATE_SUB ... INTERVAL syntax. The distinct-login input, partition and ordering, island grouping, five-day threshold, account join, projections, and final order otherwise match exactly.
